summary.text: Jamie Walsh is the Republican incumbent, in office since December 1, 2024, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 117, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Jamie Walsh earned a high school diploma from Bartlett High School and attended Whitworth College.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work in sales and as a small business owner.
